Definition: Preemptively discrediting a source so that nothing they say counts, before they have even made their case. Unlike ordinary ad hominem, it poisons the well in advance.
Example: Someone argues, 'Don't listen to him — he's just a paid shill,' before he has spoken a word.
FaithDiscussionExample: Someone argues, 'Don't read that scholar — he's an atheist, so nothing he says about the Bible counts.'
HowToRespond: Insist on a hearing: "Let's hear the argument first and judge it on its merits."
